# Gajraj Singh Shekhawat

> Gajraj Singh Shekhawat (also written Gajraj Shekhawat) is a backend and product engineer based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, with 4+ years of experience shipping production software. He works full-time as a Product Engineer at Shuru Technologies and, alongside that, builds complete products as a freelancer (APIs and microservices, Android and web apps, payments, AI features and cloud infrastructure) for schools and businesses. He is available for freelance projects.

Contact: email gaju2gajraj@gmail.com · phone and WhatsApp +91 94145 84444 · based in Jaipur, India (IST), working with clients in India and worldwide.

## Experience

- Shuru Technologies: Product Engineer (Backend), full-time, June 2024 to present. His current job. Builds backend microservices for Pickup Coffee; cut API latency by 30%, set up OpenTelemetry tracing and Redis caching, and built the referral program.
- Freelance Product Engineer, alongside his full-time job. Clients:
  - [Yugam International School](https://yugam.co), a CBSE school in Kanpur: technology partner. Built the school website, AI tools and face attendance, and leads a small team building its CRM, HR, bus-tracking and smart-classroom software.
  - [Neem Karoli Sales](https://neemkarolisales.in), a Jaipur beverage wholesaler: complete ordering platform.
  - [Shikhar Classes](https://shikharedtech.com), a coaching institute: StreamFit aptitude platform and backend API.
  - [Gram Sansad](https://gramsansad.com), a rural-governance organisation: village website platform, main site rebuild, and the founder's personal site.
- AFM Bigtech (Singapore, remote): Full Stack Web Developer, September 2022 to June 2024. Built the backend for a JEE/NEET exam-prep learning platform.
- Education: Full-Stack Web Development at Masai School (2021–2022). B.A. from Shekhawati University (2017–2020).

## Selected projects

- [Neem Karoli Sales ordering platform](https://neemkarolisales.in): two Android apps (React Native/Expo) and a Fastify + MongoDB API for a Jaipur beverage wholesaler, with self-updating apps, OTP sign-in, Cashfree payments, GST invoices and 1,290+ automated tests. Built solo.
- [Yugam AI](https://ai.yugam.co): lesson planner, chat assistant, and Indian-language call transcription and summaries, all on a self-hosted server.
- [StreamFit](https://streamfit.shikharedtech.com): adaptive aptitude test and career-stream recommender for Class 10 students, built for Shikhar Classes.
- [Gram Sansad village platform](https://gramsansad.com): multi-tenant Next.js sites with automatic DNS and HTTPS for every village, with an English/Hindi admin.
- [Yugam International School website](https://yugam.co): Next.js site with paid event passes, OTP sign-in and payments.
- Yugam Ask: an AI agent that answers plain-English questions about 1.7M Indian schools using text-to-SQL, running on a self-hosted Qwen model on vLLM with a GPU that starts on demand.
- Face attendance: marks a class present from one photo using OpenCV (YuNet + SFace) on CPU, with no cloud AI.

- Services: custom web and mobile apps; backend APIs and integrations (payments, WhatsApp, OTP, GST invoicing); AI features; performance tuning and cloud setup.
